name: ST SMA
description: This keyword returns the Supertrend value of the instrument selected. The supertrend will be calculated based on SMA. Like, most technical indicators this has to be used under the Position keyword.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Supertrend value of the instrument selected. The supertrend will be calculated based on SMA. Like, most technical indicators this has to be used under the Position keyword.

![Example](./images/img-1683120577.png)

The above keyword is checking whether the previous day close of the NIFTY 50 spot is greater than its Supertrend value

Super Trend is a trend following indicator similar to moving averages

Read about Supertrend here -  https://www.elearnmarkets.com/blog/supertrend-indicator-strategy-trading/
